basic_info.description: This enchanting four-bedroom shingled home has been painstakingly maintained and updated to offer a unique combination of period charm and contemporary amenities and comforts. The main level features a light-filled formal living room with a fireplace, a chic formal dining room with a coffered ceiling, and a bright, open family room and kitchen with a Wolf range, an island with counter seating, a sunny breakfast area, and French doors opening to a deck overlooking the backyard. Four peaceful bedrooms are secluded one level above. The sophisticated principal suite features a bay window seat, two walk-in closets, and an en-suite bath with eye-catching marble surfaces, a shower, and a soaking tub. The three guest bedrooms, each with a distinct palette and ambience, share a hall bath. An office, sitting room, or lounge on the uppermost level is adjoined by two ample closets. The home's lower level is dedicated to a spacious garage, a stylish bath, and an inviting family room opening to a patio and the gardens beyond. Accessible from two levels, the backyard is an oasis of flourishing trees and greenery that provide delightful color and coveted privacy. Located along the Lake St corridor near the Presidio and the restaurants, shops, and famed weekend farmers market of Clement St.
